prompt_travel_text: Cinematic photorealism. A vast volcanic cavern dominated by a churning, incandescent molten lava lake, dark basalt formations, and jagged stalactites. Dynamic heat haze and glowing orange embers fill the air. Seen from a first-person viewpoint, a heavy industrial cryo-blaster with frosted metallic plating and cyan energy vents is held ready. Projectiles flash-freeze bubbling magma into dense slabs of hissing glacial ice. Dramatic lighting balances intense fiery magma radiance against cool cyan cryo luminescence. The player fires a cryogenic beam into the molten lava, flash-freezing a thick ice platform with billowing steam, then steps onto it.
